offers.name: New LENOVO ThinkPad P16 G3, 16" FHD+ Nvidia RTX Pro 2000, Ultra 9 285HX, 32GB, 1TB, 2 Years Warranty, 100800-22011

praises: Cheapest way into the P16 Gen 3 HX platform with a certified RTX PRO GPU — sale price under $6,000
Ultra 9 285HX 24-core is the same flagship CPU as the $9,000 tier
RTX PRO 2000 clears SolidWorks/CAD certification for mainstream mechanical and AEC work
32GB is upgradeable later (SODIMM) rather than soldered like thin workstations
Full port set with RJ45, SDXC, HDMI and dual TB4 docking
complaints: 32GB RAM is light for a workstation-class machine out of the box
PRO 2000 VRAM and throughput limit very large scenes or local AI work
2.7 kg desktop-replacement weight and loud fans under load
FHD+ 60Hz IPS panel is entry-grade on a machine marketed as a workstation
Marketplace-seller listing rather than direct Best Buy stock

design_philosophy: The value entry into the P16 Gen 3 line: flagship 285HX CPU with an entry-mid RTX PRO 2000 GPU, aimed at CAD professionals and students who need certified drivers and HX multi-core power but not flagship GPU throughput. Sale pricing makes it the platform-access config of the family.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from PRO 5000 sibling entries 32/33 (SHARED-thinkpad-p.md, no verified pro anchor): PRO 2000 → ai_ml 6.0, gaming 5.0, creative_work 8.0 per SHARED GPU-tier guidance; keeps 285HX so productivity stays 9.0 (−0.3 vs 64GB sibling for half the RAM).
